reviews.text: I would not recommend this vet. They are very expensive and not helpful when it comes to serious illness. One of the staff members in the shop is also really sour, never smiles, never talks and is quite rude I suppose.

I just wanted to give a massive thank you to Natasha for all her help and support. It was such a stressful day trying to get my little Frenchie booked in for BOAS surgery, and she really went above and beyond to make everything easier. I’m now actually looking forward to bringing him in next week, can’t wait to meet the team, and I’m so glad she made the whole process that much smoother.

Been with this practice since Nov 2021. Mainly for my big lad for the holistic vet care. This was our 3rd vet practice since adopting him from rescue (first 2 were local) these ladies LISTENED to me the owner, that’s 5* alone in my eyes and we travel from Ayrshire for that & my cat for the conventional vet care. Nothing but praise for all staff, incl. in their shop. Costs and pricing are upfront. Great place with everything pet wise in one place 👏
Thank you Eric for your 5 star review - we really appreciate it 🤩 …

Firstly, the staff and vets are very nice. The reason the review isnt 5 stars is as follows: My dog swallowed a corn cob and the initial consultation gave an estimate of 1200-1600, unless surgery was required, which was fair enough. I then got a call from a different vet who explained surgery was required and the estimate was now £2400, again fine. Btw, I dont have insurance (just for context). Received a call from a nurse who said surgery had went well with no complications or problems - great! Arrived and before i got to see my dog, the receptionist said, "we will just clear up the bill first" and presented an invoice of £3300!! I questioned this and was taken in to see the original vet. She said the £2400 estimate WAS ON TOP of the initial cost, which was not explained in anyway and sounds like a load of rubbish to me. I told her i wasn't happy about this and asked for an intemised bill. She went away and left me in the consultation room myself for 25 mins (still hadn't seen my dog btw) and then came back to say there had been a mixup with the bill and that I had accidentally been charged twice for certain medications! The explanation was that the vets were new to the surgery and werent used to the billing system. The final bill was reduced to £2900, but still a far cry away from, "the estimate". By this point, I just wanted to get my poor dog home and forgot about the itemised bill, which i didnt receive. Again, just to reiterate, the staff were really nice, the vets were great and my dog has recovered well. I just think the discrepancy in the bill, as well as not bringin my dog to me before the bill was paid was quite poor from a customer perspective. When you combine this with recent reports of vets overcharging, its no wonder people have a distrust of vets in general. If i hadnt queried the bill then, by their own admission, i wouldve been charged twice for certain things.
Thank you for your 5 Star review - we really appreciate it 😀 …

Our girl is 7 going on 8 now, we’ve always used the natural vet and would never dream of taking her anywhere else. Everything from the decor, vibes, friendly welcome and genuine love and compassion from all of the staff is beyond anything I’ve ever seen. Rae loves to come in even though she is nervous she always has the best experience and the girls all take their time with her to make sure she feels comfortable, she never leaves without belly rubs and lots of attention. As an owner I always have complete confidence in the vets here and it’s always an open discussion with the dogs best interests at heart, and everything is explained so well that we are able to make informed choices. The opening hours are fantastic and we are usually able to get appointments really quick. Honestly couldn’t recommend enough x
Thanks James for your 5 star review.  We really appreciate it 🐾 …
I took my kitten for her vacations and the vets were so good with her. I would recommend this vet.
Thank you for you for your 5 star review - we really appreciate it 🐾 …
Thank you Lynsey for your 5 star review - we really appreciate it!
Thank you Kirsty for your 5 star review, it means a lot to our team!
Great vet practice, puts the welfare and comfort of your pet first. Holistic approach, listening to clients needs and have taken wonderful care of our dogs.

Clean waiting area with plenty of seating. Very friendly reception staff.
Vet was great at explaining everything and took very good care of my boy... He only needed boosters but the level of care was superb.
Very experienced and  knowledgeable

I can't recommend The Natural Vet highly enough. They are excellent at taking an individual pet's needs into account, for example I've noticed they'll coordinate whoever is in the waiting room so that a reactive dog can have it's stress mitigated. I was thoroughly impressed by this as it really speaks to their desire to ensure every patient receives the best possible care.

I have mainly been seen by Dr. Caitlin, occasionally by Dr. Clara and by Dr. Adele. They have all made me feel like they sincerely care about my dog as an individual and have been a source of invaluable support while we work through his various issues.

Something I find invaluable is that where I have questions as his owner about his treatment, even outwith an appointment time, they always take the time to talk with me and I've never felt like a burden for it. Quite the opposite; they truly want owners to be informed and happy.

The reception team are highly professional, personable and well trained in working with various clients and their different needs. In the past we had a mix up with our medication collection time which meant we missed a training session with our behaviourist. When I informed them of this, they implemented a system that ensured it wouldn't happen again. In almost a year we have yet to have an issue. Actually, if anything I'm the one who's been having trouble collecting and they go above and beyond to help me!

I am mentioning the above because I think it's an immense credit to the practice that they listen to concerns from owners. Our situation was arguably quite niche (live far from the practice and without a car, so we can't pop back easily) but they still went out of their way to ensure that one individual client would have an easier time in the future. This ties back to what I said about The Natural Vet taking into account the needs of each individual pet.

I'll add that the staff in the on-site shop are also wonderful. My dog is quite nervous at the vet (due to no fault of the staff - I need to get him in for more socialisation visits to build his confidence after a scare) but afterwards he pulls like a train to get round the corner to the shop, where he knows his "friends" will be waiting with treats! They have really taken an interest in helping to build his confidence with strangers and I'm so thankful to them for it.

I could go on and on but would be here all day. Highly recommend this clinic, who somehow manage to remain consistently kind, empathetic and courteous despite working in what is arguably one of the most demanding professions and contexts.

PET SHOP ONLY.

from the pets side it's been great, lovely friendly gals. Accidently got overcharged for something. Went back and pointed it out, they were very helpful, it was rectified quickly.

Recommend highly

Thank you for your lovely review. We’re so pleased to hear you’ve had a positive experience with the team. Looking after both our patients and their owners is always our priority, and we really appreciate your kind feedback.
Good with the dogs and the people
Thank you for your 5 star review Clare, we appreciate it 🐾 …
It’s a really great vet. My aunt’s been going for ages, recommended it, and I love it. The premises are lovely, the staff are lovely, and they really helped out my cat. 👍 …
The staff are lovely and never hurry us which I have heard about other vets. Genuinely caring and excellent skills.

I could not rate this veterinary practice highly enough for the end of life care they provided to our family and our 14 year old darling labrador.
They were kind, sensitive and professional at such a difficult time.
The Natural Vet will always be my first choice to care for my animals.

I really like this vet, I feel confident in bringing my bulldog here. Other vets I haven’t as they are a complicated breed with specific problems sometimes! Great bunch of people and make me feel relaxed even when my dog is a bit hyped up with excitement/anxiety. Would recommend

We visited this week for our Frenchie Walter to have his annual vaccinations.
He gets very anxious so Chelsea the vet took her time, allowing him to sniff around and chatting to keep him calm before giving his injection.
This was very much appreciated by myself. Hopefully, if/when we attend the vet's again, Chelsea will be available to look after us.

I cannot thank The Natural Vet enough for their care and attention any time I have taken my dog to them.  No matter who you see you are always welcomed with a smile.
Rebecca took excellent care of my precious girl when she was in recently with an eye ulcer.

I have only ever had positive experiences when dealing with The Natural Vet. Everyone is very pleasant to speak to and I'm confident that my cat Milo is in safe hands. If you're unsure whether to join this vet, I can highly recommend that you do!

I’m still a bit undecided. Face to face they were good but like all vets these days they are so very expensive and the follow up hasn’t been great; the receptionist promised to call me back a couple of weeks ago and I’m still waiting. Maybe I just got them on a bad day as the next time I called I got another receptionist who was helpful. Also the expectation on what a regular working person can afford is, I believe unrealistic. I think vets in general need a bit of a reality check, they might be earning mega bucks with their rates jumping up over 50% in the last 2/3 years but unfortunately not all of us have increased earnings at the same rate.
Due to a decline in the practice we made the choice to leave to ensure that my animals received the best care possible and that i wouldn't have to worry about any administrative 'glitches'

Only interested in the colour of your money.
Will prolong the illness of your pet with bad advice/wrong medication in hope of filling the boss's pockets.
Absolute zero attention to the welfare of your pet after prescribing wrong medication,  now at new vets, who have pointed out that the antibiotics prescribed are the wrong ones and my dog still has infection in her anal glands.
So much extra unnecessary suffering for the poor dog, if you want to go and see them about a refund they will charge you £55 to walk in the door. Daylight robbers.

The highest standard of care I've experienced anywhere in and around Glasgow (I wish humans could get this level of care if they need to be in hospital), and reasonably priced compared to some other places.
Individualised pet care is so important. As a cat, and dog owner, I highly recommend tailored and individualised pet care.
